title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.34707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. translated_title: 当代理模型出错时：用于自适应数据采样的失配校正老虎机
translated_abstract: 数据分配方法通常使用一个小型代理模型来为更大的目标模型选择训练数据。然而，该代理模型对数据的排序可能与目标模型不一致，从而导致次优的训练性能。为了解决这一问题，我们对代理模型与目标模型之间的失配进行建模，并将其纳入分配决策中。为此，该问题被构建为一个多保真度老虎机问题，其中每个臂对应一种数据干预。代理奖励在每一轮都会被观测，而目标奖励仅在对同一更新的稀少审计中才会揭示。这些成对的观测能够在不假设共享偏移或排序保持的前提下，识别出每个臂各自的失配。失配校正老虎机通过成对残差来校正代理模型，仅审计不确定的决策，并在整个训练过程中合理控制审计预算。从理论角度来看，我们在平稳性条件下证明了遗憾分解和下界。（原文摘要此处似乎被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出失配校正老虎机方法，将代理模型与目标模型的排序失建为多保真度老虎机问题，利用稀少审计中的成对残差校正代理奖励并智能分配审计预算，从而在无需假设共享偏移或排序保持的情况下改进大模型的自适应数据采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes mismatch-corrected bandits, casting the proxy-target mismatch as a multi-fidelity bandit problem that corrects proxy rewards with paired residuals from rare audits, audits only uncertain decisions, and paces the audit budget to improve adaptive data sampling for large model training.
